- **Step 5 (self-review)**: `python/larch/agents/agents.py` `_run_claude_with_stdin` (~line 6091) fast-fails the Claude subprocess to `EXIT_TIMEOUT` (124) when the stderr tail matches `_CLAUDE_DEGRADED_AUTH_RE` within the 60s window. That regex matches the benign `claude.ai connectors are disabled because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY takes precedence over your claude.ai login` message, which issue #5677 flags as a red herring present on successful voter runs. If that benign line is flushed to stderr during the fast-fail window, a healthy voter can be killed as a false-positive timeout, a plausible contributor to the "claude subprocess timed out" voter failures (also seen against the lint fixer during this run). Not fixed here because it risks regressing #5605's degraded-auth fast-fail; the bounded voter retry mitigates the complementary "No messages returned" failure mode. Filed as OOS for a properly-tested follow-up.

- **Step 5**: self-review mode: main-agent inline review complete. The post-review file-scoped relevant-checks composite (step5-self-review) was stopped by operator direction before completion. CI's full sweep on push is the gate. The committed implementation was already verified green by the Step 3 relevant checks (same tree, no changes since).
